reason_for_new_pilot: Pilot v4 selected its frozen corpus before uv.lock became an accepted environment source. It also spent six corpus rows on provider quota failures and led interpretation with the whole-pipeline VERIFIED fraction without separating whether the deterministic judge was reached. Pilot v5 selects a new corpus under the expanded eligibility rule, leaves quota-blocked instances unattempted for resume, and preregisters judge reach plus a dependency-install failure breakdown.

selection.repository_order: stargazers_count descending in the cached v4 source frame
selection.source_frame: Reuse the v4 public GitHub metadata and clone cache where present so the 490-repository frame is held constant; rerun every environment eligibility decision with the v5 code and fetch only missing metadata under the registered retry rule.
selection.repository_frame: First 50 repositories accepted by the current root pinned-environment parser, scanning at most 1,000.
selection.uv_lock_rule: Accept registry packages only when exactly versioned and carrying a sha256 artifact hash; skip the local project entry; reject git, URL, directory, editable dependency, missing-version, or missing-hash entries.
selection.candidate_search: First 100 merged-PR results per retained repository in the date window, sorted updated ascending.
selection.bug_indicator: Exact case-insensitive bug label OR title beginning fix, fixed, fixes, or fixing.
selection.claim: Verbatim PR title with no added expected signature.
selection.revisions: GitHub merge_commit_sha and its first parent.
selection.instance_checks: Commit date, production Python diff, accepted pinned environment on both revisions, and resolvable Git relationship.
selection.candidate_order: merged_at ascending within repository, round-robin by repository star rank.

model.confirmed_identity_rule: Record backend telemetry when present; otherwise preserve unknown_no_telemetry explicitly.

execution.sandbox: Docker, unprivileged, network disabled, credentials unavailable.
execution.outcome_retry_rule: One completed attempt per instance. Resume skips completed checkpoints. An interrupted attempt may be resumed only while its incomplete attempt remains recorded; never retry merely to seek a better verdict.
execution.provider_quota_rule: An explicit quota or usage-limit response halts the study immediately and is not checkpointed. The affected instance remains unattempted and is the first instance on resume after quota capacity returns.
execution.completion_rule: Do not publish a final v5 result until complete is true, halted_reason is null, and all 30 instances have completed checkpoints. Intermediate halted reports remain private operational state.

analysis.primary_metric: reached_judge_fraction = judged_denominator / all 30 included instances; report this first.
analysis.judged_definition: VERIFIED, PARTIAL, or a classified candidate rejection produced after a candidate was executed by the deterministic judge. Plumbing failures, proposal silence, provider unavailability, and catch-all rejections are not judged.
analysis.conditional_verification: Report VERIFIED / judged_denominator and its two-sided 95% Wilson interval immediately after judge reach.
analysis.whole_pipeline_headline: Report VERIFIED / all 30 included instances and PARTIAL separately; never merge PARTIAL into VERIFIED.
analysis.provider_unavailable: Report separately and do not absorb it into judged or proposal silence.
analysis.failure_taxonomy: fix-coverage-failure-taxonomy/v3 with the 20% catch-all refinement trigger; preserve both preregistered and any refined view without changing Cases or verdicts.

environment_dependency_install_breakdown.raw_reason_policy: Raw environment diagnostics remain private. Publish only the per-instance category and aggregate counts.
environment_dependency_install_breakdown.classification_precedence: The category order above is binding; first matching category wins.
environment_dependency_install_breakdown.validation: Applied before registration to the 17 private v4 dependency-install reasons: 5 package build/metadata, 5 unavailable distributions, 3 resolution conflicts, 1 native build, and 3 other. No raw reason is published.
environment_dependency_install_breakdown.refinement_rule: If other_install_failure exceeds 20% of dependency-install failures, refine the classifier after outcomes without changing the corpus, Cases, verdicts, or raw reasons; commit the reason and report both views.

analysis.selection_exclusions: Report repository exclusions, revision/environment eligibility exclusions, and sampling-boundary exclusions separately.
analysis.cost: Report active and end-to-end wall time plus provider-reported spend only. Unavailable model telemetry is not zero and must not be estimated from incomplete data.
analysis.interpretation: Rank the constraints and make a product-versus-research-instrument judgment without changing the corpus or rerunning completed outcomes.
